event_summary: Two men move within a large blue indoor arena while the camera moves through the space.
raw_event_description: At the start, a man in a gray hoodie is partially visible at the right edge, facing into a large blue arena, while another man in black clothing is farther ahead on the blue floor. The distant man changes position across the floor with changing arm and foot positions. The foreground man turns his head and later shows an open-mouth facial expression while remaining near the right side of the frame. The camera viewpoint moves and pans through the arena, causing the blue walls, seating, and black wall opening to shift in the image.
